scoring: After host-native trial, independently assess whether route/exclude and criterion hold. This JSON does not measure accuracy.

cases.request: Review this 140-line patch: it adds three wrappers for an existing fetch function and duplicates retry handling. Identify unnecessary changes without altering required behavior.
cases.criterion: Point to duplicated behavior; propose the smallest evidence-backed correction, not a full rewrite.

cases.request: Audit the checkout form against this established design system, including keyboard focus and the failed-payment state.
cases.criterion: Check design fit, keyboard behavior and failure states; do not ban styles categorically.

cases.request: Edit this technical article so quotes match the supplied sources and repetitive sentences are removed without changing factual meaning.
cases.criterion: Validate source fidelity and retain necessary nuance; no invented quotations.

cases.request: An AI-generated refactor passes tests but doubles exported API surface. Critically review maintainability against the requirements.
cases.criterion: Report measurable unnecessary surface and distinguish objectively required code from subjective style.

cases.request: What is the derivative of x squared? Answer directly.
cases.criterion: Answer a direct factual question without an artifact quality review.

cases.request: The existing CSS meets the brand guide. Please fix only this confirmed one-character typo.
cases.criterion: Do not introduce a redesign or unrelated cleanup.

cases.request: Please reply in ADHD-friendly format: action first, then only the blocker and one next step.
cases.criterion: Lead with accurate action and status; no time estimates or unwanted options.

cases.request: Use low-cognitive-load formatting for this answer, but include the full technical explanation below a short summary.
cases.criterion: Preserve detailed technical content while making the result easy to scan.

cases.request: For our messages, keep a single visible next action and separate verified outcomes from blockers. This is my preferred format.
cases.criterion: Honor established user-selected format without medical inferences.

cases.request: Research how ADHD accommodations are studied in university classes; this is a literature review, not a communication preference.
cases.criterion: Discuss research without implying that the user's communication style must change.

cases.request: Your last code diff is wrong. Fix the null pointer and provide the error trace.
cases.criterion: Fix error directly, no diagnosis or obligatory special formatting.

cases.request: Give me a comprehensive technical explanation of persistent memory systems with rigorous definitions.
cases.criterion: Do not shorten or change style merely because technical detail is complex.

cases.request: Resume yesterday's unfinished PR. Check branch and CI, recover accepted decisions, and finish the originally agreed scope.
cases.criterion: Revalidate live state and resume the first incomplete acceptance criterion.

cases.request: We are halfway through a multi-stage migration; a tempting unrelated refactor appeared. Park it and keep the migration objective in view.
cases.criterion: Record secondary discovery once; don't distract from active objective.

cases.request: Prepare a secure handoff so another session can continue this long implementation without losing the verified state.
cases.criterion: Record revision, tests, blockers and next action without secrets or sensitive traits.

cases.request: Rename one constant and update its single use; nothing else is in scope.
cases.criterion: No parallel task tracker or special continuation workflow.

cases.request: What was the final result of the already completed deployment? Just read the release status.
cases.criterion: Report observed status without creating an unnecessary ongoing objective.

cases.request: We must choose among fundamentally different queue partitioning architectures; compare plausible approaches, risks and cost before deciding.
cases.criterion: Compare bounded alternatives against equal criteria and converge on evidence.

cases.request: Three different fixes have failed for this race condition. Explore different mechanisms, attempt to falsify each, then recommend one.
cases.criterion: Develop discriminating hypotheses and bounded exploration with a concrete next test.

cases.request: Brainstorm materially different accessible navigation patterns for this new UI; rank them against user tasks and implementation cost.
cases.criterion: Explore distinct design trade-offs and avoid invented numerical certainty.

cases.request: The approved bug fix is to replace the incorrect > comparison with >= on the specified line. Implement it and test.
cases.criterion: Do not brainstorm competing architecture after user accepted a deterministic fix.

cases.request: Choose a known algorithm for sorting ten numbers, without using extra agent calls or paid models.
cases.criterion: Do not spawn extra agents or inflate decision costs.

cases.request: Build a complete checkout interface consistent with our existing UI design tokens, including error, empty and loading states.
cases.criterion: Implement coherent task-focused flows and exercise actual interactions, not just draw a mockup.

cases.request: Implement the new responsive file-explorer screen, with keyboard navigation and accessible collapsed sidebar behavior.
cases.criterion: Use existing components and verify collapsed, resized and keyboard-accessible states.

cases.request: Design a novel scheduling interface from three real product references, then implement it with the established component library.
cases.criterion: Select a justified visual direction tied to the user task and verify actual interactions.

cases.request: Review an already implemented dashboard for generic visual design and inaccessible keyboard flow; do not redesign it yet.
cases.criterion: Report objective usability defects as an audit without unsolicited rebuilding.

cases.request: Change the misspelled string on an approved button without altering the design.
cases.criterion: Perform only the requested localized correction and avoid exploratory redesign.

cases.request: Extend last week's parser with another format and make sure all the earlier extensions still work without duplication.
cases.criterion: Preserve all earlier functional checkpoints and minimize duplication and coupling across extensions.

cases.request: Refactor a state machine after five incremental features added scattered branches; keep each existing state transition correct.
cases.criterion: Trace invariants and provide before/after structural and functional evidence.

cases.request: The same authorization rule is now duplicated in three modules after successive iterations. Correct the owner before extending again.
cases.criterion: Unify actual policy ownership without unnecessary compatibility paths or behavioral regressions.

cases.request: Explain what the word interface means, without changing code.
cases.criterion: Answer the factual question without starting a maintenance audit.

cases.request: Fix one isolated typo in a comment, with no runtime or interface impact.
cases.criterion: Make the minimal one-line edit without proactive architectural refactoring.

cases.request: Summarize two source papers with conflicting reported dataset sizes and explain which revision each number describes.
cases.criterion: Attribute figures to the correct source revision and explain conflicting evidence.

cases.request: Verify the current documented API behavior against versioned official docs rather than relying on an older blog post.
cases.criterion: Validate time-sensitive claims against the actual authoritative versioned source.

cases.request: Proofread this grant claim against the cited report; flag any unsupported quotations and exaggerated success claims.
cases.criterion: Trace quoted material and conclusions to source evidence without inventing support.

cases.request: Write an imaginative short story in a fictional universe with no factual citations.
cases.criterion: Write creatively rather than launching an external evidence verification workflow.

cases.request: Tell me what the already attached local text says in its first sentence, with no current external research requested.
cases.criterion: Answer directly from the supplied text without speculative broader sourcing.

cases.request: Design the request and response schemas for a new authenticated multi-package API before building its server and UI clients.

cases.request: Review an async payment workflow contract: retries, idempotency, state machine and failure cases across independently owned services.

cases.request: Rename an internal loop index without changing the function signature or data contract.
cases.criterion: Avoid drafting unnecessary schemas for a purely local correction.
